name: com.sipv.assetloader
description: Reusable, performant, extensible runtime asset loading library for Unity. RAM/disk caching, request dedup, pluggable sources/decoders/processors/policies.

samples.description: Registers a decoder for a made-up asset type from outside the package, proving Open/Closed extensibility.
Adds an XOR content processor to the fetch/decode chain (production should use AES).
A single-retry-no-backoff IRetryPolicy, usable globally or per-request.
